summary.tldr: Creates rules for online platforms to label, remove and keep records about deepfakes, and adds administrative monetary penalties for violations.
what_it_does: Requires online operators to set up a process, including user reporting, to identify deepfakes shared through their services.
Requires operators to take reasonable steps so deepfakes shared through their services are clearly identified as deepfakes.
Requires operators to take reasonable steps to stop deepfakes that may cause significant harm from being shared, and to remove them as soon as feasible after identification.
Requires operators to keep records and data needed to show compliance with the act, and lets the Governor in Council make rules about those records.
Creates an administrative monetary penalties scheme for violations, with penalty amounts set by regulation and possible liability for directors or officers who took part.
summary.background: The bill defines deepfakes as photo, video or audio recordings altered or made with AI to use a person's appearance or voice, when meant to seem authentic. It applies to owners or operators of online undertakings and social media services accessible in Canada.
